notes: Adds a local Shared Sync contact verifier to diagnose the receiving-phone discrepancy after the 56-record transfer. The verifier compares emergency contacts in the already-unlocked Vault with emergency contacts in the Hub authorization session and can refresh the authorized session from the Vault without changing Vault data. No traveler records or trip confirmations were altered.
